screeningInstructions:
Before beginning the main study, please complete this short listening task.

For each item, listen carefully to Version A, Version B, and Version C. Version A is identical to one of the other two versions. After listening to all three versions, select whether Version A matches Version B or Version C.

You may replay the versions as needed before submitting your answer.
